static_traits.name: Zhang Cheng
static_traits.social_status: Has several close friends, but struggles to discuss the fear of loneliness with them
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems before; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to concretely describe emotions and thoughts; fairly good cooperation, neutral tone; often overthinks and automatically jumps to negative conclusions

basic_info.main_problem: I keep experiencing thoughts and feelings of loneliness, especially worrying about growing old alone and dying lonely, because no one is willing to marry me.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because the fear of growing old alone has become unbearable, affecting my mental health and enjoyment of daily activities.
growth_experiences: Experiencing several failed relationships in the past year, this series of events significantly intensified fear of loneliness and lifelong singleness.
At social gatherings seeing happy couples, and when alone on quiet nights, often triggered into strong loneliness and anxiety, accompanied by low mood and disturbed sleep and appetite.
No similar psychological distress or treatment experience before; long-term living alone.

core_beliefs: No one is willing to marry me

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am alone now, I will always be alone later, eventually growing old lonely
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distracts attention by playing video games, cooking, and playing guitar
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will grow old alone and die lonely

special_situations.event: Seeing happy couples at social gatherings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have no partner right now, it means no one will want to be with me long-term
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Emotionally 'shuts down', reduces in-depth interaction with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never find that kind of happiness

special_situations.event: After several relationships ended in failure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one relationship fails, it means all future relationships will fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids talking to friends about fears, digests emotions alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am destined to stay single forever

special_situations.event: When thinking of discussing one's loneliness fears with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express these worries, friends will think I am pathetic
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Choosing not to talk or being vague, avoiding exposing vulnerability
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will look down on me

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted by the partner with long-term commitment, to have a stable intimate relationship
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being rejected, being seen as 'pitiful', ending up lonely for life
defense_goal: Avoiding exposing vulnerability to avoid being judged
Repressing painful emotions by diverting attention
Shutting down emotions at strong triggers for self-protection

object_relations.object_representation: Partners/others who will reject me, unwilling to be with me long-term

object_relations.self_representation: A help-seeker afraid of being looked down upon
object_relations.object_representation: Friends will think I am pitiful and look down on me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing happy couples in social situations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing this proves one cannot possibly have such happiness (good-bad splitting tendency between self and others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use short, objective descriptions, reducing emotional vocabulary, avoiding in-depth discussion of one's own feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of discussing the fear of loneliness with friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing friends will find oneself pitiful (transference: projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use hypothetical language (e.g. 'they might...'), avoiding directly expressing needs or requesting support.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When overwhelmed by anxiety on lonely nights
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Feeling that without displacing attention one will collapse, needing to quickly suppress uncomfortable emotions
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Quickly switching the topic to daily activities (games, cooking), weakening the detailed expression of negative emotions.

manifestations: Worrying about growing old alone and dying lonely
Loneliness and intensified anxiety when seeing happy couples at social gatherings
Finds it hard to open up to friends about fears
outcomes: Decreased enjoyment of interests, low mood

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Worrying friends will find oneself 'pitiful', projecting self-evaluation as others' views
Assumes others will reject oneself in social settings

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection with excessive self-restriction and reproach, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Hesitates whether to express true fears to friends, overly concerned about others' evaluations
Cautious in socializing and avoids deep interaction

positive_force: Having stable interests and skills (cooking, playing guitar, video games), which can briefly ease emotions
Willing to try small steps and openly explore different perspectives
Having several friends to discuss average matters with, with basic social support
negative_force: Significant negative cognitive patterns such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and predicting the future
Comparing in social situations and falling into despair, prone to emotional shutdown
Afraid of others' evaluation and avoids expressing vulnerability
Long-term living alone intensifying loneliness and triggering anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Experiencing significant anxiety and emotional 'shutdown' when seeing happy couples at social gatherings
antecedent: Seeing happy couples at social gatherings
target_behavior.core_reason: Forming the belief 'no one will want to be with me long-term' after recent failed relationships, accompanied by catastrophizing and overgeneralizing thinking
target_behavior.function: Escaping loneliness and potential rejection experiences, reducing emotional pain in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Worsening social experiences, difficulty building and maintaining intimate relationships, further reinforcing loneliness

target_behavior.behavior: Excessively worrying about the future on lonely nights, leading to disturbed sleep and low mood
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative anticipation of the future (predicting the future) and overgeneralization triggering persistent anxious rumination
target_behavior.function: Trying to gain control through worrying, and briefly relieving discomfort by diverting attention
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep disturbance,Decreased appetite,Work focus and performance affected
